tickets.title: Prepare appreciated stock donation analysis for Nora Velvetreed
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison for Nora Velvetreed of donating cash versus low-basis Paper Otter Robotics shares to the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund at Silver Marmot Foundation, including the expected reduction in concentration and the records needed for the transfer.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that appreciated stock donation analysis by March 20, 2024.

tickets.title: Review Paper Otter Robotics lots for charitable funding
tickets.text: Review Nora Velvetreed's concentrated Paper Otter Robotics stock lots in the taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody to identify charitable funding candidates, noting the large unrealized gains and lot-selection details relevant before she chooses assets for the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review concentrated employer stock for charitable lots by March 27, 2024.

tickets.title: Address charitable giving timeline for filing package
tickets.text: Address the charitable giving timeline for Nora and Sam Velvetreed before Priya Dewspindle's filing package closes, confirming which prior charitable records belong in the 2023 federal return package and which gifts are only current-year planning items.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the charitable giving timeline before the filing package closes by March 25, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain Silver Marmot Foundation contribution receipt
tickets.text: Obtain or resolve the missing contribution confirmation from Silver Marmot Foundation for Nora Velvetreed's bank transfer to the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund, so the deductible donor-advised fund gift can be substantiated for Priya Dewspindle's filing package.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain or resolve the donor-advised fund contribution receipt by March 22, 2024.

tickets.title: Reconcile Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund balance
tickets.text: Reconcile the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund portal balance of about $48,200 against Nora Velvetreed's downloaded activity summary, checking whether pending grants, investment movement, or timing of deposits explains the difference.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to reconcile the donor-advised fund balance by March 29, 2024.

tickets.title: Support pending Marzipan Meadow Rural Clinic grant review
tickets.text: Support Nora Velvetreed's review of the pending grant recommendation to Marzipan Meadow Rural Clinic in the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund portal at Silver Marmot Foundation, determining whether the foundation needs additional information to move the grant forward.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to support that pending grant recommendation review by March 18, 2024.

tickets.title: Add eldercare grant category to charitable plan
tickets.text: Address the charitable plan for Nora and Sam Velvetreed after Hazel Velvetreed's move into assisted living, adding a modest annual grant category for eldercare access organizations in Hazel's county to the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund priorities.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the charitable plan after that family caregiving change by April 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA-ready charitable documentation packet
tickets.text: Prepare a single CPA-ready charitable documentation packet for Priya Dewspindle that separates Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund contributions, donor-advised fund grants, and any direct charitable gifts so deductible and non-deductible records do not mix.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA-ready charitable documentation packet by April 12, 2024.
